slug: Toddler’s First Guide to Being a Good Friend
tagline: 50 Illustrated Social Skills for Kids Ages 2–5: A Preschool Friendship Book About Kindness, Sharing, Taking Turns, and Caring for Others
title: Toddler’s First Guide to Being a Good Friend
description:
Toddler’s First Guide to Being a Good Friend is a warm, illustrated social-emotional learning book for children ages 2–5. Through 50 simple, age-appropriate lessons, young children discover how to say hello, share toys, take turns, listen, use kind words, recognize feelings, include others, solve problems peacefully, and care for friends.

The book uses gentle language and engaging illustrations to make social skills easy to understand and practice. Each page introduces one positive friendship behavior that parents, caregivers, and teachers can model during everyday play and routines.

Topics and skills listed in the description include:
- Kindness, empathy, and caring
- Sharing and taking turns
- Listening and using gentle words
- Saying please, thank you, and sorry
- Understanding feelings
- Inviting others to play
- Handling big emotions
- Respecting personal space and boundaries
- Solving problems without pushing
- Welcoming new friends
- Being a good sport and trying again
- Celebrating differences and being yourself

The book is presented as suitable for toddlers, preschoolers, classrooms, daycare settings, bedtime reading, and as a gift for families, parents, teachers, and caregivers who want to encourage kindness, emotional learning, and positive behavior.
